title: Add a bulk release workflow
context: Release several repositories in one run while keeping one tag per package version.

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: `release.sh bulk --repo a --repo b` or a manifest file.
Per-repository preflight before any tag is pushed.
Stops on the first failure and reports what was released.
Re-running is idempotent for already released versions.
